scientific_integrity: The unrestricted theorem follows from exact inequalities for all u>=34 and exhaustive rational comparisons only for the proved finite boundary 2<=u<=33. Finite checker output is corroboration, not a proof of the infinite portion.
scientific_limitations: Applies to strict two-term underapproximations of 5/(5m+1), m>=1, not to other numerators or term counts; possible unindexed earlier equivalent classification remains a priority risk.
title: Periodic best two-term Egyptian underapproximations on the first threshold-four numerator ray
